'''Thule droid factories''' were in use by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thule/Legends|Thule]] throughout the [[Battle of Thule]]. They were capable of rapidly assembling [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]], [[Heavy Artillery Gun]]s, [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|spider walkers]], and [[Ground Armored Tank]]s.

==Description==
These factories were heavily armored, capable of emerging unscathed from the firepower of a [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank]]. Any craft assembled were capable of being deployed from one of two of its bay doors in a matter of seconds. Some factories were protected by tower [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]].<ref name="Clone Wars" />

==History==
During the battle of Thule, they supplemented Separatist forces by deploying numerous amounts of tanks against the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] encountered several of these factories during the second phase of the battle, in which he was tasked with eliminating [[Energy farm]]s protecting a Separatist [[Command Installation]].<ref name="Clone Wars" />

En route to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kesiak]], at least two of these factories were destroyed by two squads of [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]] led by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]].<ref name="Clone Wars" />
